mapper.sql: c.id, c.order_no as orderNo, u.username as userName, co.name as courtName, c.booking_date as bookingDate, c.start_time as startTime, c.end_time as endTime, c.remark, c.total_price as totalPrice, co.type, c.status, c.create_time

sql.where:
and u.username like CONCAT('%',#{userName},'%')
and co.name like CONCAT('%',#{courtName},'%')
and c.is_deleted = 0

mapper.select:
select from court_booking c left join court co on co.id = c.court_id left join user u on u.id = c.user_id
order by c.id
mapper.update: update court_booking set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into court_booking ( id, order_no, user_id, court_id, booking_date, start_time, end_time, total_price, status, remark ) values ( #{id}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{courtId}, #{bookingDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{totalPrice}, #{status}, #{remark} )
mapper.select: select c.id, c.order_no as orderNo, co.name as courtName, c.booking_date as bookingDate, c.start_time as startTime, c.end_time as endTime, c.remark, c.total_price as totalPrice, co.type, c.status, c.create_time from court_booking c left join court co on co.id = c.court_id where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.is_deleted = 0 order by c.id desc
select id from court_booking where is_deleted = 0
select start_time,end_time from court_booking where court_id = #{courtId} and booking_date = #{bookingDate} and is_deleted = 0
select * from court_booking where id = #{orderId} and is_deleted = 0

SELECT cb.id, cb.order_no, cb.user_id, cb.court_id, cb.booking_date, cb.start_time, cb.end_time, cb.status, cb.remark, cb.is_reminded, cb.total_price, u.username, u.email, c.name AS court_name, c.type AS court_type FROM court_booking cb LEFT JOIN user u ON cb.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN court c ON cb.court_id = c.id WHERE cb.status = 1 AND cb.is_reminded = 0 AND cb.booking_date = #{targetTime}
